description: The OpenUGD package family as the tools see it. 'root' holds one checkout (or worktree) per repo; OPENUGD_ROOT or --root overrides it. Relative paths here ('root', 'smokeProject', 'il2cppSmokeProject') are relative to the upm-tools folder; the defaults assume the author's layout, with upm-tools in <workspace>/v2/repos/ and the packages in <workspace>/OpenUGD/Assets. 'packages' is the default set for level1/level2, in dependency order. finish.sh fast-forwards 'target' to 'source' in the main checkout that owns each worktree.

release.description: release-check.sh: the version the train is tagged as (each tag equals package.json 'version', no prefix, as the existing tags are) and the 'unity' minimum every package declares (DECISIONS-v2: minimum Unity 6000.0).

outsideTrain.note: com.openugd.configuration 0.x: checked by level 1 when listed with --packages; not part of the 2.0 release and has no main checkout yet.
